from calendar_core import day_summary
from calendar_core.slots import Event, fmt_duration, free_slots, overlaps


def test_issue_example():
    """Example 09:00-10:00 and 09:30-11:00 in 08:00-12:00 gives 2 events busy 2h longest free 1h."""
    events = [Event(540, 600), Event(570, 660)]
    # busy union [540,660) = 660-540 = 120 -> "2h 00m"; gaps [480,540)=60, [660,720)=60 longest 60 -> "1h 00m"
    assert day_summary(events, 480, 720) == "2 events | busy 2h 00m | longest free 1h 00m"


def test_issue_singular():
    """Write `1 event` (singular) when N is 1."""
    events = [Event(540, 600)]
    # busy 600-540=60 -> "1h 00m"; gaps 540-480=60, 720-600=120 longest 120 -> "2h 00m"
    assert day_summary(events, 480, 720) == "1 event | busy 1h 00m | longest free 2h 00m"


def test_issue_no_events():
    """Zero overlapping events gives `0 events` with empty busy and whole day free."""
    events = []
    # busy 0 -> "0h 00m"; free 720-480=240 -> "4h 00m"
    assert day_summary(events, 480, 720) == "0 events | busy 0h 00m | longest free 4h 00m"


def test_issue_overlapping_counts_once():
    """Total time covered by at least one event counts overlapping events once."""
    events = [Event(540, 600), Event(540, 600)]
    # busy union [540,600)=600-540=60 (not 120) -> "1h 00m"; gaps 60,120 longest 120 -> "2h 00m"
    assert day_summary(events, 480, 720) == "2 events | busy 1h 00m | longest free 2h 00m"


def test_issue_partly_outside_clipped():
    """Events partly outside the day are clipped and still count as overlapping."""
    events = [Event(420, 540)]
    # clipped to [480,540)=540-480=60 -> "1h 00m"; free [540,720)=720-540=180 -> "3h 00m"; N=1
    assert day_summary(events, 480, 720) == "1 event | busy 1h 00m | longest free 3h 00m"


def test_issue_touching_day_edge_not_counted():
    """N is the number of events that overlap [day_start, day_end) as half-open intervals."""
    events = [Event(360, 480), Event(720, 780)]
    # [360,480) ends at day_start and [720,780) starts at day_end share no minute so N=0; busy 0; free 720-480=240
    assert day_summary(events, 480, 720) == "0 events | busy 0h 00m | longest free 4h 00m"


def test_issue_full_day_no_free():
    """Longest free is `0h 00m` if there is no free gap inside the day."""
    events = [Event(480, 600), Event(600, 720)]
    # busy 120+120=240 -> "4h 00m"; back-to-back leaves no gap -> "0h 00m"
    assert day_summary(events, 480, 720) == "2 events | busy 4h 00m | longest free 0h 00m"


def test_issue_longest_free_wins():
    """D2 is the length of the longest free gap inside the day formatted with fmt_duration."""
    events = [Event(540, 550), Event(600, 610)]
    # busy 10+10=20 -> "0h 20m"; gaps 540-480=60, 600-550=50, 720-610=110 longest 110 -> "1h 50m"
    assert day_summary(events, 480, 720) == "2 events | busy 0h 20m | longest free 1h 50m"


def test_contract_back_to_back_no_overlap():
    """Back-to-back events (one ends exactly when the next starts) do not overlap."""
    # [480,540) and [540,600) share no minute -> False
    assert overlaps(Event(480, 540), Event(540, 600)) is False


def test_contract_fmt_duration_format():
    """fmt_duration renders Xh YYm (e.g. 65 -> 1h 05m)."""
    # 65 = 1*60 + 5 -> "1h 05m"
    assert fmt_duration(65) == "1h 05m"


def test_contract_free_slots_clipped():
    """Events partly outside the day are clipped to it."""
    events = [Event(420, 540), Event(660, 780)]
    # clipped to [480,540) and [660,720), gap [540,660) with 660-540=120
    assert free_slots(events, 480, 720, 1) == [(540, 660)]
